messages.content: An insulated picnic cooler contains ice at 0 C in a 30 C room. It has no powered refrigeration. Explain in two short sentences what the insulation does and whether it can prevent the ice from melting indefinitely. Do not use tools.

Insulation slows heat from the 30°C room reaching the ice, reducing how quickly it melts. It cannot prevent the ice from melting indefinitely, because eventually enough heat will get through and the ice will keep melting until it is gone.
